b1-hquama-phrases.title: Fixed Phrase: хъуама (must/should)
b1-hquama-phrases.explanation: хъуама means "must/should", but the verb that follows it takes a special subjunctive-like form that isn't a simple rule yet confirmed from a reliable source. Rather than guess at how to build new sentences with it, this course presents the two attested examples as fixed phrases to recognize.
b1-hquama-phrases.fact: Both attested examples use different-looking verb endings (акӕной, фӕхонай) even though both mean roughly "must do something" -- a sign that the rule behind them is more complex than "хъуама + one fixed ending", which is exactly why it's not taught as a productive pattern yet.
